metaTitle: Custom 3/4 Sleeve Tank Tops | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom 3/4 sleeve tank tops for your team or event. Perfect for outdoor work or casual uniforms. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Custom 3/4 sleeve tank tops offer a practical middle ground between short sleeves and full coverage, making them ideal for outdoor crews, summer events, or casual uniforms where you want sun protection without overheating. The extended sleeve provides a sporty look that stays in place during physical activity, while the open neckline keeps air flowing. Choose from cotton blends for softness or performance fabrics for moisture-wicking, and add your logo with screen printing or embroidery for a professional finish that lasts through repeated washes.
heroAltText: Custom 3/4 sleeve tank tops with embroidered logo, available in multiple colors for bulk orders
